关键词: Redemption of Class A Preference Shares
主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced the redemption of its Class A Preference Shares, Series 11, for cash with a redemption date of September 30, 2012. The redemption price will be C$25.00 per share, plus any accrued and unpaid dividends. Notice of redemption has been sent to all registered holders, and payment will be made to beneficial holders on or after October 1, 2012 through CDS & Co., and to other registered holders on October 1, 2012.
